thread:
Alyssa (AE): quick heads-up — SignalPath CISO flagged the BYO-KMS section in their security questionnaire. They want HSM residency attestation before any POC traffic. POC paused until we confirm.
Mike (Solutions Eng): ack. can you paste the exact clause? want to scope if it's origin/residency or additional indemnity.
Alyssa (AE): they sent: 

> "All cryptographic keys used to protect customer data must remain under Customer custody in an HSM certified to FIPS 140-2, physically located in the EU; vendor must provide written attestation and evidence of integration before testing."

Sara (Security): that's stricter than our hosted baseline. two practical paths: (A) offer Private deployment with direct KMS integration and provide attestation (we do support HSM-backed BYO-KMS), or (B) propose an envelope-key approach where customer keys never leave their HSM — but legal may reject. Both need counsel review.
Jon (Platform Eng): from infra side, we can spin a Private test stack in eu-west-1 and connect their HSM over site-to-site VPN or VPC peering. ETA: ~36-48 hours if prioritized. We'll need a short windows for handshake tests.
Priya (Sales Lead): customer timeline: they want written confirmation within 72 hours or they won't proceed with the on-site demo. We should escalate to execs.
Alyssa (AE): proposing exec bridge tomorrow 09:00 PT with their CISO + our Security lead. I'll send invite once Sara confirms.
Sara (Security): I can join. I'll draft a one-page attestation template and the minimal SQ redline language Legal can accept.
Legal (Counsel Bot): note — avoid absolute guarantees. Use demonstrable facts (e.g., "we validated integration to X HSM model and can demonstrate connectivity in a Private deployment"). Anything promising indemnities or unlimited liabilities needs legal review.
Mike (Solutions Eng): I'll prepare a short tech brief for the CISO: network diagram, key flow, sample KMS policy snippet (scrubbed). Will attach to invite by EOD.
ops-bot: BYO-KMS runbook: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/byo-kms-poc — includes checklist for Private, network steps, evidence artifacts.
Jon (Platform Eng): ops note: request a temp service principal from the customer to validate mutual TLS handshake and an HSM signing test. Also ask for HSM model + FIPS cert PDF up front.
Alyssa (AE): adding artifacts to request in the invite: HSM model + FIPS cert, short-lived service account for handshake, allowed egress IPs, and expected data residency clause.
Priya (Sales Lead): also flag pricing delta: Dedicated/Private may change economics — finance should be notified. Alyssa, add finance to the invite as FYI.
Sara (Security): action items: I'll draft attestation + redline language; Jon: prepare deployment ETA & ops checklist; Mike: tech brief for CISO; Alyssa: schedule exec bridge and request artifacts; Priya: coordinate customer execs and loop finance.
Alyssa (AE): will do. If anyone can't make 09:00 PT, DM me now. I'll post the calendar link here after sending. :thumbsup:
